title: Ferrari 812 on a Desert Highway at Dusk
label: PARKED & PEACEFUL
description:
Parked & Peaceful: a gunmetal grey Ferrari 812 Superfast on a desert highway at dusk, a warm desert wind on an empty highway at dusk. 4 hours of slow, original lo-fi with the weather soft underneath, for working, studying, relaxing or drifting off to sleep.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original to this channel.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
